---
title: "Begin the synthetic practice"
---

**Question:** How do community composition and diversity vary between two groups?

Use 24 synthetic samples, 12 per group, and 15 fictional features to learn the workflow. You will produce three figures, inspect the tables, and write a short explanation.

Complete [workspace setup](../../00-setup.qmd) once before running commands.

## How to follow along

1. Preview the supplied figures to see what you will produce.
2. Meet the three input files and check their identifiers.
3. Run the practice analysis using the shared command page.
4. Compare your figures with the tables and write your explanation.

::: {.callout-note}
The figures describe this teaching dataset. Your task is to explain the visible patterns and check the numbers. An optional sample calculation is available if you want to inspect how Shannon diversity is obtained.
:::
